newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 21.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- Results from Japan's national elections show the Liberal Democratic Party winning a major victory.
- New York City's economy has begun to recover from its slump as profits rise on Wall Street.

- The representative of the wealthy Indonesian family that donated money to U.S. President Bill Clinton's election campaign is receiving unwanted attention from the ensuing political scandal in the United States.

- Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole has called for changes to laws that regulate campaign finances in order to avoid unfair advantages apparently held by presidents when they run for a second term in office.
- The two major political parties of the United States are finishing a fall congressional election campaign with aggressive television advertising.
